title: Record the sparse E8 coset deficiencies
body:
## Summary
- The 120 E8 root lines, after transport to the identity form, are exactly the 9-bit vectors of weights 3 and 7: 84 and 36 of them. Label parity agrees with geometric orthogonality.
- Four sparse outside cosets of the `F3` evaluation code have deficiency sums 9, 9, 9, and 7. Each is at most 9. All 6560 nonzero codewords have binary support rank 9. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The 130305-pair exhaustion is not rerun.
